claims.head: Carolina’s shot volume meets a soft spot
claims.body: Carolina ranks 3rd of 32 for shot volume (65.8 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Chicago ranks 26th of 32 for shot suppression.

claims.body: Chicago ranks 9th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.6% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Carolina ranks 24th of 32 for avoiding breakdowns.
